mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (as indicated by high housing starts), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1300, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% for two consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong GDP growth (GDPC1) in the prior quarter (above 2.5% annualized) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply contraction regimes (as indicated by INDPRO below 100.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
